The abstract describes a framework that includes a Retrieval-augmented Generation mechanism, used alongside a fine-tuned LLM to optimize decision-making. It reports experiments. RAG is one component of the system, not the sole focus, and the abstract does not say whether the LLM is conditioned on retrieved text. That uncertainty argues against a firm include. The rules say to include if experiments are run with a RAG system, and this paper does run experiments on a system that contains a RAG component. The domain is driving control, which is not multimodal-only RAG as far as the abstract shows. The retrieval details are unclear, but the paper plausibly qualifies, so MAYBE or INCLUDE are both defensible. I lean toward INCLUDE because the abstract names a RAG mechanism and reports experiments, but the unclear retrieval details make MAYBE the safer call.
